condition: Calling add() with day units on a dayjs object converted with tz() across a DST transition keeps the old UTC offset, so the resulting instant is off by an hour.
workaround: Re-apply the timezone after adding, e.g. dayjs.tz(d.tz(zone).add(30,'day').format('YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss'), zone), or do the arithmetic in UTC and convert with tz() afterward.
